message.content:
Electric skillets fall under HTSUS 8516.60, "Other ovens; cookers (for example, cooking stoves, ranges), cooking plates, boiling rings, grillers and roasters." The 8516.60.40 subheading covers "Cooking stoves, ranges and ovens; other: Other" and the 8516.60.60 subheading covers "Other." Electric skillets are generally classified under 8516.60.6000 in CBP rulings. I recall 8516.60.40 as "Cooking stoves, ranges, and ovens," 8516.60.60 as "Other" and 8516.60.80 as "Other"... In the current schedule, 8516.60.40 is "Rice cookers," 8516.60.60 is "Other cooking stoves, ranges, ovens", and 8516.60.80 is "Other." Electric skillets are covered by 8516.60.80 "Other," and I believe the full code is 8516.60.8000. I'm not fully certain of the statistical suffix, but I recall CBP rulings on electric skillets using 8516.60.8000.

{"hts_code": "8516.60.8000", "reason": "A household electric skillet with a heating element is an electrothermic cooking appliance of heading 8516, falling in the residual 'other' cookers subheading 8516.60.80."}
